descripcion: Reel vertical 9:16 para TikTok e Instagram: presentadora a camara, frases cortas, sin B-roll. El discurso no se corta.
escena: Vertical 9:16 composition. A woman of about thirty-five with dark hair in a neat low bun, wearing a charcoal blazer over a white shirt, looking straight into the camera. Medium close-up from the chest up, her face and shoulders occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame, the lower fifth visually quiet and uncluttered for captions. Even soft broadcast lighting, no hard shadows. Behind her a deep navy newsroom wall softly out of focus, a muted abstract graphic, no readable text. Static locked-off camera, clean unstylised news look.
ambiente: A very quiet studio room tone with no identifiable sounds, and the clear measured female dialogue spoken by the presenter.
apoyos: Extreme close-up of a hand scrolling on a smartphone, screen glow on the fingers, no readable text.
A city avenue at dusk from a high window, traffic lights moving, no identifiable faces.
Over-the-shoulder of a laptop on a news desk, the screen out of focus, a mug and a recorder beside it.
notas: Todas las tomas son informativo a proposito. Un plano de apoyo en este pipeline dura LO MISMO que una toma hablada (8 s a 192 fotogramas), y el modelo no genera voz en off: ocho segundos de silencio rompen un reel. El B-roll queda en 'apoyos' por si se pide --broll con tomas cortas (107 f = 4,5 s). 416x736 no esta medido como formato: es el mismo producto de pixeles que 736x416 (VRAM equivalente). La primera tanda real dira si el modelo respeta el encuadre vertical.
